Please take a moment

Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers must confirm pet travel details before departure so Aurelia Skyways can complete the correct checks and keep the journey orderly.

The passenger coordinator will review documents, crate readiness, and cabin or hold handling, while the welfare coordinator checks comfort needs and loading limits. <<FACT F063>> Please keep the animal calm, secure, and ready for inspection at the desk.

For reptile travel, use an approved crate that meets the stated side limit. <<FACT F072>> Pack the crate cleanly, allow proper ventilation, and remove loose items before arrival. Follow the guidance given by staff, because each journey is a shared responsibility.

Please report to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for final assistance and verification.
